posts.headline: Fifty editions and Thicks still hasn't bought a receipt — Klint's Clipboard sits 6-2 but 934.5 points-for is the thinnest resume a ring has ever worn in this league.
posts.detail: A 1-14 career finish average and one title doesn't erase the math: the Clipboard is winning ugly, and ugly eventually catches up.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers keep stacking points and triciagloston is now undeniable, not a sleeper, the standard.
posts.detail: At 6-2 with a league-best 1128.92 points-for, the Bakers have turned a 5-average-finish rookie campaign last year into the best scoring machine in Busters Anonymous this season.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is still the worst show on the slate at 1-7 and the name has never been more ironic.
posts.detail: A 12th-place career average finish and 798.32 points-for say this isn't a slump — it's the truest form Du Bois never imagined.

posts.headline: Sasinci is frozen at 4-4 and Big Head's title defense is now a historical footnote nobody bothers to open.
posts.detail: One ring and a 13-15 career record later, Alxgalvn's 905.74 points-for says this roster is coasting on reputation alone — and reputation doesn't win weeks.

posts.headline: Fifty editions of chronicling One Nut Barner's fall and Put it in Ra is still stuck at 2-6, the most spectacular collapse this league has ever logged.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and 1.5 average finish — the best pedigree in Busters Anonymous — now sits beside 874.16 points-for and a losing record, proof that nothing is sacred in this league.
